fullPassage: Writers such as Braudel and Mukeiji make an important point, namely, that conspicuous or luxury consumption did not start with the emergence of capitalism. Yet even though the fundamental elements of a consumer culture — the use of goods for both social positioning and as a symbolic means of self-expression — were both in place by the nineteenth century, it is only with the rise of industrial capitalism that a full-blown consumerism appeared. After the eighteenth century, activities that were once restricted to the elite were now practiced by the masses as well. A flood of common industrial goods swept over the market that itself expanded through new opportunities for buying. Innovations such as the department store made shopping a regular and attractive activity. Fashion became a social force and led to the cyclical abandonment and adoption of different styles whether goods were still useful or not. Status or standing was marked by consumption differences extending to the veritable limits of social groupings in society. The appearance of mass advertising aimed at ordinary citizens through newspapers, radio, popular magazines, and later television stimulated purchasing and innovated an entire language of media-assisted consumption. Braudel Mukeiji .

det.korean: Braudel과 Mukeiji가 지적하는 핵심(namely), 19세기에 자리 잡은(in place) 소비자 문화의 요소, 새로운 기회를 통해 확장된(expanded) 시장, 일반(ordinary) 시민을 겨냥한 대중 광고에 관한 내용이다.

✅ ③ ordinary: 'aimed at ordinary citizens'에서 '일반적인'이라는 의미의 형용사로 올바른 어법
det.tip: 관계대명사 that 뒤에는 주절 동사가 와야 합니다. 'the market that itself expanded'에서 expanded는 과거 시제 동사이며, expanding으로 바꾸면 문장에 동사가 없어집니다.

(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 지위나 위상은 소비 차이로 표시되었다.
det.analysis: 주어 Status or standing + 동사 was marked + 전치사구 by consumption differences. 수동태 'be marked by ~'(~에 의해 표시되다) 구조이며, or로 연결된 두 주어(Status, standing)는 동의어 관계로 단수 취급하여 was가 적절하다.
det.tip: A or B가 주어일 때 동사는 B에 수 일치시키는 것이 원칙이며, standing은 불가산이므로 was가 맞습니다. be marked by(~로 표시되다)는 수동태 관용 표현입니다.
